subject: reasoning
question: In a code language, ‘REACTION’ is written as ‘9 - 22 - 26 - 24 - 7 - 18 - 12 - 13’ and ‘SCIENCE’ is written as ‘8 - 24 - 18 - 22 - 13 - 24 - 22’. How will ‘CHEMICAL’ be written in that language?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 
The pattern followed in the given codes is:

 **The alphabets are coded as the positional value of opposite alphabet.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59193ffa889f1192ce265582974f931b032bd3c4f8395ce51379cc12a0c6ce8e.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/533839e6977b3a5a79041102eb4da147085b1a39f79c51203c88e099565efa9e.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/292475d416dcbd1d8a7620d28b47a76fe2ee0ae98537d4e1a7b99ef4973dee4b.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"option (1)".**
